entities.summary: Roger Hilton CBE (1911–1975) was a pioneer of abstract art in post-Second World War Britain. Often associated with the 'middle generation' of St Ives painters – Terry Frost, Patrick Heron, Peter Lanyon & Bryan Wynter – he spent much of his career in London, where his work was deeply influenced by European avant-garde movements such as tachisme and CoBrA. Roger Hilton was a authors & novelists from Northwood (1911-04-30, Northwood–1975-02-23). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
